Create Gmail filters on the already signed-in account tyson.goulding@optconnect.com in this box's Chrome. Open https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#settings/filters

If a Google login or "verify it's you" appears that needs a password/2FA, STOP and report sign-in required. Do not invent credentials. If a verify popup appears after filters are saved, Cancel it.

These labels already exist: Carrier, Internal, External, Incidents, Customer, calendar, NOISE, Jira.

A filter already exists: from:(no-reply-ops@lattigo.com) Push Handler → Skip Inbox, Mark as read, NOISE. Leave it.

Create these NEW filters. For each: Create a new filter → set criteria → Create filter → check actions → check "Also apply filter to matching conversations" when the action skips inbox OR when we want backfill labels → Create. Gmail UI allows only ONE apply-label per filter.

1. From: no-reply-ops@lattigo.com
   Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, Apply NOISE, Also apply to matching.
   (Broader than the Push Handler one; covers reboot lists.)

2. From: googlecloud@google.com OR engage@b2me.cisco.com OR email@mail.salesforce.com OR gallup@e.gallup.com OR Success@pagerduty.com
   Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, Apply NOISE, Also apply.

3. From: rewardgateway.net
   Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, Apply NOISE, Also apply.

4. From: notifications@github.com
   Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, Apply NOISE, Also apply.
   Do NOT include noreply@github.com.

5. From: no-reply@pagerduty.com
   Actions: Apply Incidents ONLY. Do NOT skip inbox. Do NOT mark as read. Also apply to matching so existing incident gets the label.

6. From: t-mobile.com OR att.com OR support@tealcom.freshdesk.com
   Actions: Apply Carrier ONLY. Do NOT skip inbox. Do NOT mark as read. Also apply to matching.
   Do NOT use verizon.com.

7. Has the words or subject if the UI has a Subject field: Invitation:
   If Subject field exists: Invitation:
   Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, Apply calendar, Also apply.
   Then create THREE more small ones if needed: Subject "Updated invitation:", Subject "Canceled event", Subject "Declined:" — same actions. If one filter can OR subjects, do that instead.

8. From: gemini-notes@google.com
   Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, Apply calendar, Also apply.

CRITICAL SAFETY:
- Never skip inbox or mark read for: no-reply@lattigo.com Secure Token, net-eng@optconnect.com, tyson.goulding@ personal To, teal, t-mobile humans, att.com humans, no-reply@pagerduty.com.
- Do not edit or delete other existing filters except you may leave the Push Handler one as-is.
- Do not send or delete mail.
- If a current filter dumps ALL lattigo.com or no-reply@lattigo.com (not ops) to NOISE, do not delete it in this pass; just report it so we can narrow it later.

Report: each filter created (criteria + actions), any failures, whether signed in as tyson.goulding@optconnect.com, and any existing filter that would dump Secure Token to NOISE.
